dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Me? Just thinking about some recent tasks that need to be completed.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: This week, I have to observe some experiments and record their results at Pardis Dhyai. It's also about time to draw up the next patrol schedule for the rangers...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Nothing especially urgent, though, so this can all wait.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: So? Anything in particular you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Oh? So then, why did you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll go ahead. Please answer one question for me.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Yes or no: Do you want to rub my ears?

choices.text: Wha... You're turning this back to me!?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Don't blame me, I gave you the opportunity to go first.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Actually, uh... I don't really mind if someone I'm close to rubs my ears, you know?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'm not sure why, but everyone always seems to think that it would make me angry.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Over time, "Do not discuss ears or tails in Tighnari's presence" became something of an unspoken rule.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: It can sometimes be quite amusing to watch people's faces as they stumble over their words.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: It's probably for the best, anyway. It might get irritating if people I barely knew started coming up to me and getting all touchy-feely.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're saying that I can...?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: They might not feel as nice as you're imagining, though. They honestly just feel like anything you'd find on a regular cat or dog.

choices.text: Well, I'll be the judge of that.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I give you an inch, so you take a mile?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'd be willing to take hundreds of group photos with you, so a pat or three is nothing.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Your gaze seems to have been wandering slowly earwards the whole time we've been talking.
